title: Momwe HAX inakulira
eyebrow: Kukula, kugwiritsanso ntchito ndi zomwe zimasungidwa
peopleText: Aliyense amene wathandizira, akukula kuchokera ku {root}: akakhala kutali kwambiri, ndiye kuti analowa pambuyo pake. Aliyense amawala ndi ntchito yake yaposachedwa (ma commit ku nkhokwe iliyonse ya HAX, nkhani zotsegulidwa ndi nkhani zotsekedwa mu mzere wa nkhani wa HAX), amatentha kwambiri akakhala otanganidwa ndipo amazimirira m'miyezi yotsatira.
peopleKey: Kuwala, kuchokera chete mpaka kutentha koyera
selectPerson: Sankhani munthu kuti muwone nthawi yomwe analowa ndi zomwe wachita.
didWhat: Ma commit: {commits}. Nkhani zotsegulidwa: {opened}. Nkhani zotsekedwa: {closed}.
agentsText: Ma commit olembedwa ndi ma AI agent, omwe amagwira ntchito m'nkhokwe za HAX pamodzi ndi anthu amene amawayendetsa, kuyambira {date}. Pano amawerengedwa pamodzi, osati ngati anthu.
noPeople: Palibe deta ya othandizira m'gwero ili.
chartHint: Pa sikelo ya logarithm, kukwera kowongoka kumatanthauza kuchulukitsa kosasintha, ndipo kupindika m'mwamba kumatanthauza kuti kukufulumira.
chartData: Deta ya tchati, malinga ndi chaka
cacheSite: Cache: tsamba ndi tsamba, saiti ndi saiti
rateThemes: Mitu yatsopano {n} m'miyezi 12 mpaka {date}: pafupifupi umodzi pa masiku {days} aliwonse.
preCore: Mitu yoyambayi imabwera pakati pogawana pa mitu pasanafike, pomwe pamafika pa {date}; mutu uliwonse pano umamangidwa pambuyo pake pamenepo.
coreText: Mutu uliwonse umatsitsa pakati pogawana pomwepo: {core} wopanikizidwa ndi gzip m'mafayilo {files}. Mutu wamba umawonjezera {own} wake, pafupifupi {pct}% ya pakati. Ma hexagon amajambulidwa pa sikelo imeneyo.
selectTheme: Sankhani mutu kuti muuyerekeze ndi pakati.
themeCost: Ulendo woyamba ku saiti ya {name} umatsitsa {first}. Mlendo akaona kale saiti ya clean-one pa host yomweyo, imafunika {after} kuwonjezera.
twoLayers: Umamangidwa pa {base}, choncho umagwiritsanso ntchito zigawo ziwiri.
elText: Maphukusi ogwiritsidwa ntchito kwambiri ali pakati; chilichonse chowazungulira chimamangidwa pa iwo. Ogwiritsidwa ntchito kwambiri pofika {date}: {top}. {ddd} mwa maphukusi {n} awa amamangidwa pa DDD. Kukula kwa hexagon ndi fayilo yaikulu ya phukusi lililonse, lopanikizidwa ndi gzip; mzere wagolide umasonyeza maphukusi omwe ena 20 kapena kuposerapo amawagwiritsa ntchito.
selectElement: Sankhani chinthu kuti muwone chomwe chimadalira (lalanje) ndi chomwe chimachigwiritsa ntchito (buluu).
platText: Zonse zimagwira ntchito pa mtundu umodzi wa saiti, site.json: zina zimayendetsa masaiti, zina zimawamanga kapena kuwasintha, ndipo PRAW imasunga malamulo ake.
platKey: Zamitundu: masaiti a mu bala ya netiweki ya HAX, mu mitundu yawo ya netiweki. Zotuwa: mapulatifomu omwe amayendetsa ndi kumanga HAX. Kukula kumakula ndi ma commit mpaka pano; mphete imagunda ndi ma commit a mwezi uliwonse.
selectPlat: Sankhani imodzi kuti muwone ntchito yake.
siteIntro: Mlendo amawerenga masamba ochepa a saiti imodzi ya HAX, kenako amapita ku saiti yotsatira pa host yomweyo. Pakati pa masamba a saiti, zinthu zokhazo zomwe tsambalo limawonjezera ndi zomwe zimatengedwa.
themeIntro: Mlendo amatsegula saiti imodzi ya HAX pambuyo pa inzake pa host yomweyo, iliyonse ndi mutu wosiyana, motsatira momwe mitu inapangidwira.
firstStep: Tsamba loyamba la HAX pa host limatenga chilichonse: {need} m'mafayilo {files}.
laterStep: Gawo ili likufunika {need}; {cached} yake ili kale mu cache, choncho limatenga {fetch} yokha.
bundleSite: Ngati tsamba lililonse likanakhala phukusi lake
bundleTheme: Ngati saiti iliyonse ikanakhala phukusi lake
unbundled: HAX: mafayilo osapakidwa pamodzi, osungidwa mu cache fayilo ndi fayilo
cacheKey: Ma sello alalanje akutengedwa tsopano, agolide anali kale mu cache. Ma sello okhala ndi mzere ndi pakati pogawana.
sources: Masiku: nthawi yomwe fayilo iliyonse inaonekera pa njira yake yapano, ndi commit yoyamba ya nkhokwe iliyonse. Ma byte: gzip ya gwero la fayilo iliyonse, fayilo ndi fayilo, kupatula khodi ya anthu ena. Masakatuli amasunga cache imodzi pa saiti iliyonse, choncho zosungidwa pakati pa masaiti zimagwira ntchito pa host yomweyo.
drawing: {view} pa {date}: {n} zawonetsedwa. Gulu lomwe lili pambali limalemba ziwerengero zomwezo.
